title: BECAUSE · החלטה
sentence: I charge my phone because the battery is dead.
he: אני מטעין את הטלפון כי הסוללה ריקה.

title: In light of

base: I charge my phone because the battery is dead.

sentence: As a result of the dead battery, my phone is off.
